findings.evidence: JHolomorphic/Energy/Basic.lean:97-103 "the definition is neither `@[expose]`d nor reducible, so no module ever unfolds the body again"; Energy/Integral.lean:100-103 repeats it. Every neighbouring manifold file uses plain `public section` (Manifold/AlmostComplex.lean:47, Manifold/JHolomorphic.lean:62, Geometry/Manifold/TwoForm.lean:43).
findings.fix: Use plain `public section`. The `_def` lemmas plus the `Tames`/`Compatible` lemmas are the intended elimination API; nothing needs to unfold or compute these two defs.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes the bodies of `stdComplexLineEnergyDensity` (l.109) and `stdComplexLineEnergy` (l.456) to every downstream module, while `attribute [irreducible]` (l.122, l.469) is added as if they were hidden. The linear originals do the opposite and say so explicitly.

findings.evidence: Geometry/Symplectic/AlmostComplex.lean is `public section` with per-declaration `@[expose] def Invariant` (l.425) and `@[expose] def Tames` (l.443). Energy.lean:394 `have hinv_step : form x (J x w) (J x v) = form x w v := hinv x w v` is the only use in the PR that needs an unfolded body.
findings.fix: Revert to `public section` and put `@[expose]` on the predicate defs a consumer must apply (`Invariant`, and `Tames` if needed), exactly as the linear file does; or add an application lemma `Invariant.apply : form.Invariant J → form x (J x v) (J x w) = form x v w` and expose nothing.
findings.issue: `public section` is flipped to `@[expose] public section`, exposing every body in the file (`IsNondegenerate`, `symplecticFormAt`, `Tames`, `Invariant`, `constSmooth`), apparently only so that Energy.lean:394 can apply `hinv x w v` directly. `symplecticFormAt` and `constSmooth` already have `@[simp]` characterizations (`symplecticFormAt_apply` l.93, `constSmooth_apply` l.179), so their bodies should stay hidden.

findings.fix: Write `:= (rfl)` in both, matching the repo idiom.
findings.issue: `stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_def` is proved `:= rfl`, and `stdComplexLineEnergy_def` (l.467) likewise, letting consumers depend on defeq of the bodies.

findings.evidence: Energy/Integral.lean:28-31: "The differential is kept explicit: for a differentiable map `u`, consumers use `fun x ↦ (fderiv ℝ u x).toLinearMap`. This avoids assigning a misleading energy to a nondifferentiable map, since Mathlib defines `fderiv` to be zero where differentiability fails." No `MDifferentiable` hypothesis occurs anywhere in the new file.
findings.fix: Parameterize over the differential field, `du : ∀ z, (ℝ × ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] TangentSpace I (u z)`, mirroring `SymplecticForm.stdComplexLineEnergy`, and derive the `mfderiv` statements as lemmas about `fun z ↦ (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ × ℝ) I u z).toLinearMap`.
findings.issue: `stdComplexLineEnergy` hard-codes `mfderiv` inside the definition, so a curve that is nowhere `MDifferentiable` gets energy `0` (Mathlib's `mfderiv` junk value) and satisfies `Tames.stdComplexLineEnergy_eq_zero_iff` (l.573) vacuously. The linear predecessor deliberately avoids this.

findings.evidence: grep for `map_add₂|map_sub|map_neg` in TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/TwoForm.lean returns only the structure field and the coercion (l.66, 77, 83, 185); no bilinearity lemma exists.
findings.fix: Add the missing characteristic `@[simp]` lemmas to `TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/TwoForm.lean` — `map_zero_left/right`, `map_add_left/right`, `map_sub_right`, `map_neg_right`, and antisymmetry `form x v w = -form x w v` — and use them here.
findings.issue: Proofs bypass the public `form x v w` coercion and reach into `form.toContMDiffSection x` for bilinearity (l.134-135, 226, 389, 391, 393), and re-derive antisymmetry from `LinearMap.IsAlt.neg` + `simpa [bilinFormAt_apply]` three times (l.229-231, 395-397, 398-400). `SmoothTwoForm` has no additivity or antisymmetry lemmas.

findings.evidence: l.262-266 `lemma mfderiv_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_nonneg (htame : form.Tames J) (u) (z) := htame.stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_nonneg (u z) _`; contrast l.431 `Compatible.two_mul_twoForm_mfderiv_le_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity` in `SmoothTwoForm.Compatible`.
findings.fix: Move them to `SmoothTwoForm.Tames` (e.g. `SmoothTwoForm.Tames.mfderiv_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity_nonneg`), matching where this PR already puts the equally hypothesis-free `Compatible.two_mul_twoForm_mfderiv_le_stdComplexLineEnergyDensity`.
findings.issue: Eight lemmas live in `IsPseudoholomorphicAt` (l.262, 270, 280, 289) and `IsPseudoholomorphicWithinAt` (l.325, 333, 343, 353) but take no pseudoholomorphicity hypothesis — they are `Tames` specializations with `u`/`z` explicit, so dot notation on the namespace's type is impossible and the names advertise a hypothesis that is not there.

summary: The PR exposes definition bodies file-wide in both the new file and the pre-existing Manifold/TwoForm.lean, contradicting the documented no-expose design of the linear energy files it lifts, and its `_def` lemmas use bare `rfl`. It also bakes `mfderiv` into `stdComplexLineEnergy` (the sibling file deliberately kept the differential a parameter), works around missing `SmoothTwoForm` bilinearity lemmas by reaching into `toContMDiffSection`, and files eight tameness lemmas under `IsPseudoholomorphic*` namespaces they have no hypothesis in.
